messages:
Luca: Quick heads-up — planning to enable a console feature flag for advanced prefs (hidden settings) to a 5% org canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need product + QA + SRE sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Anjali: Which rollout system are we using, feature-gates or rollout-service? Also, any audience scoping?
Luca: rollout-service. We'll target orgs with <500 seats and only toggle the UI surface (backend read-only). Guardrail: auto-disable if error-rate > 3% over 5m.
Devin: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/429 — wiring + telemetry. pinging @Maria for review.
Maria: Saw the PR, two minor nits on naming and a comment. I'll do a proper review EOD and leave approvals if all good. :thumbsup:
Kyler: Staging test plan I will run: 1) enable flag on staging org, 2) verify preferences render, 3) smoke test save/persist, 4) check telemetry events and latency. Running at 15:00 PT.
Samir: Can we make sure the backend handler remains unchanged? We only want the UI to expose the setting for the canary. No backend schema changes.
Luca: Correct — UI only. Backend will continue to ignore hidden prefs for non-canary orgs.
Ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z (deploy-bot)
Anjali: Communication plan: I'll draft a short engineering note and update the rollout playbook (docs/rollouts/console-hidden-pref.md). Also a changelog entry.
Maria: QA: add regression checks for persistence after toggling, and a test for idempotent saves. I'll add those to the PR comment.
Kyler: Adding rollout-service guardrail config snippet here:
```json
{ "audience": "org_sample_5pct", "scoping": "seat_count < 500", "start_time": "2026-03-19T17:00:00Z", "auto_rollback": true, "rollback_metric": "console.errors.5m.rate", "rollback_threshold": 0.03 }
```
Devin: Merged the PR after Maria's review. @Maria please approve release when you confirm staging smoke.
Maria: Done — staging smoke passed. Left one follow-up about a log message but not blocking. Approved for canary.
Kyler: Setting up Grafana panels + alert: error rate >2.5% and p95 latency >500ms for advanced prefs API. I'll attach dashboards to the rollout.
Samir: If persistence regressions show up, we should have a hotfix branch prepped. I'll create a patch branch just in case.
Luca: Plan: staging canary today at 15:00 PT; prod canary 2026-03-20 17:00 PT if monitoring is clean. If any guardrail trips, rollout-service will auto-disable and I'll notify #incidents and #product.
Anjali: I'll send a short heads-up to customer success and include rollback steps + contact list.
Luca: Thanks — will post a brief status update in #product before the prod push.
Kyler: Added dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abc123/advanced-prefs
Ops-bot: rollout-service: canary started on org_sample_5pct (audit id rsl-20260319-01)
